heading: Saint of the Day
name: Saint Jude the Apostle
story: Jude was one of the Twelve apostles, not Judas Iscariot. At the Last Supper he asked Jesus why he would reveal himself to his disciples and not to the world. Jesus answered by speaking of love, keeping his word, and making a home with those who love him. Jude invites us to listen and live that love.
provenance: Brief story based on Benedict XVI’s October 11, 2006 audience.
bookDek: Read and listen together to Jude’s question and Jesus’ answer.
bookCredit: Imaginative storybook illustration, not a historical portrait.
sourceLabel: Feast source: Maronite Eparchy of Saint Maron, Canada
bookAlt: Illustrated Jude among the apostles in the children’s storybook
